body_provenance.assumption: CAD inter-segment yaw joints locked at zero; wheels with zero joint limits locked; no wheel spin or one-way clutch dynamics
body_provenance.omitted: CAD segment 1, unselected subsequent segments, separate steel ribbons, unmodeled fasteners/cables/guide additions; servo internals remain as exported in plate-link inertials
body_provenance.aggregation: Each actual plate and wheel is used once; adjacent back/front plates retain their CAD spacing and share one dynamic body; parallel-axis sum at aggregate COM

metadata.model: Sano steel + CAD rigid bodies + ideal tension-only cables + sampled plane penalty/friction contact
metadata.contact: 12 surface samples per steel edge plus 2x rim samples per plate; no continuous CCD; quasi-Newton contact geometric Hessian
